description: Elaboración de productos petrolíferos y gas licuado is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Petróleos Mexicanos (PEMEX). Producción total de gas licuado, gasolinas, querosenos, diésel, combustóleo y otros petrolíferos en miles de barriles diarios. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Petróleos Mexicanos (PEMEX). Its tags are explotación hidrocarburos, extracción petróleo, industria gas, industria petrolera, petróleo. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-09-24 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
